title: Observer::group_info: put ratchet_tree last, not first
description:
mls-ratchet-tree-options-02 (PR mlswg/mls-ratchet-tree-options#6, closes #4) now says: for implementations that support PartialGroupInfo, if the ratchet_tree extension is ever present in the signed GroupInfo, it MUST be the last element in the extension list. A PartialGroupInfo whose group_info_extensions contains ratchet_tree is rejected (mimid already does this).

mimid puts it FIRST: crates/mimi-mls/src/observer.rs Observer::group_info (~line 940, builds vec![RatchetTree] then extends with partial's extensions). Rebuilt GroupInfos from spec-conformant committers will fail signature verification.

Do:
- Append the ratchet_tree extension after group_info_extensions instead of prepending.
- Update the module doc (observer.rs ~line 37) and the group_info doc comment ('preceded by'), and cite -02 instead of -01 §4.
- Supersede decision mimid-1wgh.4.46 (ratchet_tree first, as OpenMLS does).
- Check whether mimid ever signs a GroupInfo itself (committer side) with OpenMLS's default order, which puts ratchet_tree first; if so, that GroupInfo must also put it last. Unverified.
- Tests need an independent oracle for the signed bytes (e.g. a GroupInfo signed by mls-rs, which appends ratchet_tree), not one built by Observer itself.
close_reason: duplicate of mimid-1wgh.4.71 (extra items merged into its notes)
